title: 坊っちゃん（冒頭）
src: 青空文庫（夏目漱石『坊っちゃん』）
body: 親譲りの[[無鉄砲|むてっぽう]]で[[小供|こども]]の時から損ばかりしている。小学校に居る[[時分|じぶん]]学校の二階から飛び降りて一週間ほど[[腰を抜かした|こしをぬかした]]事がある。

腰を抜かした: Literally: legs gave way from shock.

paragraphs.zh-Hant: 我遺傳了父親的莽撞，從小到大總是吃虧。上小學的時候，曾經從學校二樓跳下來，結果腰閃了，躺了一個星期左右。
paragraphs.zh-Hans: 我遗传了父亲的莽撞，从小到大总是吃亏。上小学的时候，曾经从学校二楼跳下来，结果腰闪了，躺了一个星期左右。
paragraphs.en: I inherited my father's recklessness and have been losing out since I was a child. When I was in elementary school, I jumped down from the second floor of the school and was so badly hurt in the back that I couldn't get up for about a week.
paragraphs.de: I inherited my father's recklessness and have been losing out since I was a child. When I was in elementary school, I jumped down from the second floor of the school and was so badly hurt in the back that I couldn't get up for about a week.
